subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “Sam put the best pages in a folder.”?
options: Sometimes a mistake can become an idea if people are willing to look at it differently.
Yesterday's news had become a window into a world that had not expected to be studied.
It showed that Grandpa was willing to enter a new world, one number at a time.
Some small objects help people rest because they hold a quiet world that does not hurry.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Sam put the best pages in a folder. Yesterday's news had become a window into a world that had not expected to be studied.」，答案為「Yesterday's news had become a window into a world that had not expected to be studied.」。
